caseName: Mississippi River Fuel Corp. v. Federal Power Commission
caseNameFull: Mississippi River Fuel Corp. v. Federal Power Commission
attorneys: Thomas Fletcher and C. Huffman Lewis for movant-respondent.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The motion of United Gas Pipe Line Company to correct and amend the title and caption is granted and the United Gas Pipe Line Company is designated as a party respondent.
